title: Galois category
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $F:\mathcal C\to\mathbf{Sets}$ a
functor. The pair $(\mathcal C,F)$ is a *Galois category* if

1. $\mathcal C$ has finite limits and finite colimits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits];
1. every object of $\mathcal C$ is a finite (possibly empty) coproduct [def-galois-finite-coproduct] of
*connected* objects [def-galois-connected-object], where $X$ is connected if it is not initial and
every monomorphism $Y\to X$ is either an isomorphism or has initial
source (initial objects and monomorphisms as in [def-galois-initial-mono]);
1. $F(X)$ is finite for every object $X$;
1. $F$ is exact [def-galois-exact-functor] (it commutes with finite limits and finite colimits)
and reflects isomorphisms [def-galois-reflects-isomorphisms] (if $F(f)$ is bijective then $f$ is an
isomorphism).

For a functor with all $F(X)$ finite, $\operatorname{Aut}(F)$ is
identified with the subgroup of
$\prod_X\operatorname{Aut}(F(X))$ formed by the tuples induced by the
natural automorphisms of $F$, and carries the topology induced from the
product of the discrete topologies [def-galois-aut-topology].

split_report.summary: Definition split against Stacks 0BMY (pione.tex, definition-galois-category), read with Categories 002C, 002J, 003B, 0034, 04AS and the paragraph of Section 0BMQ before Lemma 0BMR. The statement agrees with 0BMY clause by clause (it omitted '(possibly empty)', now added; trailing ';' fixed); every notion now cites a node, all seven new nodes Mathlib leaves: finite limits/colimits (HasFiniteLimits/HasFiniteColimits), initial object and monomorphism (IsInitial, Mono), connected object (PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected, which assumes only a category), finite coproduct (Cofan + IsColimit, Finite index), exact functor (PreservesFiniteLimits/PreservesFiniteColimits), reflects isomorphisms (Functor.ReflectsIsomorphisms), topology on Aut(F) (PreGaloisCategory.instTopologicalSpaceAutFunctorFintypeCat). The finiteness of F(X) needs no node. The imported stmt_dep def-galois-fibre-functor was removed: it is the etale fibre functor of FEt(Y) and the abstract definition does not use it. The item is not a Mathlib leaf: Mathlib's PreGaloisCategory + FiberFunctor are the SGA1/Lenstra axioms G1-G6, which do not agree with 0BMY clause by clause (see mathlib_comparison); the candidate is recorded in mathlib_candidate.
mathlib_comparison: 0BMY(1) finite limits: Mathlib assumes terminal + pullbacks (G1, Basic.lean 68-70), equivalent to finite limits (instance HasFiniteLimits, Basic.lean 125). Agree.

0BMY(1) finite colimits: Mathlib assumes only finite coproducts and colimits of shape SingleObj G for finite G (G2, Basic.lean 72-76); coequalizers and pushouts are not assumed (they follow only from the equivalence with finite Aut F-sets). Mathlib assumes less.

0BMY(2) every object a finite coproduct of connected objects: not assumed by Mathlib; derived for GaloisCategory C as has_decomp_connected_components (Decomposition.lean 119), using the fibre functor.
Mathlib G3 monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummand (Basic.lean 77): not an axiom of 0BMY; for a Stacks Galois category it is a consequence (via 0BMY(2), Lemma 0BN0 and exactness of F), not stated in 0BMY.
0BMY(3) F(X) finite: Mathlib's F lands in FintypeCat (Basic.lean 84); agrees after composing with FintypeCat.incl, which creates finite limits (Limits/FintypeCat.lean 45).

0BMY(4) exact: Mathlib's FiberFunctor assumes preservation of terminal object, pullbacks (G4), finite coproducts, epimorphisms and quotients by finite groups (G5) (Basic.lean 86-96); left exactness agrees, right exactness is weaker in Mathlib (coequalizers not assumed preserved).
0BMY(4) reflects isomorphisms: Mathlib G6 reflectsIsos (Basic.lean 98). Agree.
Connected: Stacks' definition = Mathlib PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected (Basic.lean 102). Agree.
Topology on Aut(F): Mathlib Galois/Topology.lean 78, same as Stacks 0BMQ. Agree.
